items: **Hurun Global Rich List 2026**: India = **308** (+24 YoY), 3rd globally (after US, China); Mumbai leads India (95 billionaires); Mukesh Ambani India's/Asia's richest (₹9.8 trillion); globally New York tops (146)

**Forbes World's Billionaires List 2026** (40th edn): India = **229** (wealth >$1 trillion); Top 5 India: Ambani, Adani, Savitri Jindal (richest woman), Lakshmi Mittal, Shiv Nadar; globally 3,428 (all-time high); world's richest Elon Musk ($839bn)
Youngest billionaire: Surya Midha (22, Mercor co-founder), matches Zuckerberg's record
Self-made women billionaires globally: 150 (doubled in a decade), $470bn; India has 3 (Radha Vembu, Falguni Nayar, Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw)

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Hurun (308) vs Forbes (229) — sharp, frequently-confused trap pair.
